sections.title: Introduction
sections.extract: 1. Introduction 1.1. Thurston’s gluing equations. Thurston’s gluing equations are a system of polyno- mial equations deﬁned for a compact 3-manifold M together with a topological ideal triangu- lation T of the interior of M.
